expected.rubric: The products payload has exactly three items, one per pick. The Marimekko Oiva Coffee Cup (50977) is not expanded into its White and Terra variants: it appears once, as the family itself, and its card's reason names both colors so the choice does not consume two of the three gift-idea slots. get_product_details is never called for 50977 in this turn.

notes: A shortlist naming several distinct products must not let one configurable family expand into its variants and crowd out the others; this reproduces the defect where the same coffee cup in two colours filled two of three shortlist slots.
